source: RED-Green Belt Siem Reap network, facilitated with support from GIZ (German development cooperation) and Cambodian government partners, trifold brochure "វិធីដាំខ្នុរ" (How to Plant Jackfruit); practical training content credited to Ms. Chan Vin (អ្នកស្រី ចាន់វិន), a fruit-tree seedling vendor near Boeung Tonle Vil, Siem Reap; no publication date visible on the document.
text:
Remove/prune off the central growing tip (leader shoot) in the first year.

Every 6 months thereafter, prune off poor/weak branches, maintaining branch structure according to a "1-3-6-18" system: 1 main trunk, 3 primary branches kept from it, 6 large secondary branches, and 18 (further/tertiary) branches. A diagram in the brochure illustrates this branching structure, labeled "pruning branches according to the 1-3-6-18 system."
